_comment: Registered private-anatomy reaches with a named application receiver. NOT a baseline and NOT an obligation: nothing here is consumed, so a registered reach still fails `--check` and the cross-repo red stays red. The register only names where each reach lives, when it entered, and who must drain it. An id present here and in baseline.reaches is an error. When the audited corpus is the revision an entry was measured at, its count must reproduce exactly; a drained or changed entry is a failure, so the register cannot fossilise.
